queue.claim: At selfie distance (~30 cm) the nasal base looks about 30% wider than at ~1.5 m (Ward et al. 2018), consistent with pinhole magnification (d+0.10)/d. This underpins the engine's thresholds: warn below 1.0 m, refuse as a shape cue below 0.6 m.

queue.claim: FaceBuilder's EULA lets users reuse an exported head as a base for distributed or commercial work (unverified). The add-on is a GPL front end that downloads a closed core library.
